title: B2B Data Protection & Breach Notification Regulation
content:
Article 1: Scope and Definitions
This regulation governs automated processing of personal customer records by B2B software processors operating within the European Economic Area.

Article 4: Incident Notification Deadline
Upon discovering a confirmed personal data breach, the data processor must notify the controller without undue delay and no later than 72 hours after detection, including affected record counts and mitigation steps.

Article 7: Audit Log Retention
Access logs and cryptographic audit hashes must be retained in append-only storage for a minimum of 24 months and purged automatically after 60 months unless subject to active litigation.

title: Commercial Fixed-Price Milestone & Escrow Settlement Policy
content:
Section 1: Milestone Funding Requirement
Engineering execution begins strictly after the client approves the technical specification and funds Milestone 1 inside the designated escrow account.

Section 2: Acceptance & QA Verification
Every milestone delivery must include automated unit tests and reproducible CLI commands. Clients have 5 business days to verify deliverables against the agreed acceptance criteria before automatic escrow release.

title: Normativa Interna de Retención de Facturas y Contratación B2B
content:
Artículo 3: Conservación de Facturas Electrónicas
Todas las facturas electrónicas emitidas a clientes corporativos deben conservarse en formato estructurado PDF y XML durante un plazo mínimo de 6 años para inspecciones fiscales.

Artículo 5: Escalamiento de Incidencias Críticas
Cualquier caída de integración de webhooks o pérdida de sincronización contable debe escalarse al responsable técnico en menos de 2 horas hábiles.
